title: Cloud Migration and Modernization Support Services
description: CISA requires contractor support to migrate legacy on-premises applications to FedRAMP-authorized cloud environments. Scope includes assessment of 40 applications, refactoring, CI/CD pipeline setup, and zero trust architecture alignment. Period of performance is one base year with four option years. Offerors must hold an active Secret facility clearance and demonstrate past performance on at least two cloud migrations of comparable size. Evaluation is best value tradeoff, with technical approach weighted more heavily than price.

title: Enterprise Help Desk and IT Service Management
description: The VA seeks Tier 1 and Tier 2 help desk support for approximately 12,000 users across regional offices. Contractor shall operate a 24/7 service desk, maintain ServiceNow instances, and meet SLAs of 90 percent first-call resolution. Contract type is firm-fixed-price with a 3-year period of performance. Section 508 compliance is required for all deliverables.

title: Cybersecurity Assessment and Penetration Testing
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE ARMY
description: Army Cyber requires annual penetration testing, vulnerability scanning, and RMF documentation support for 15 mission-critical systems. Contractors must supply personnel with CISSP or OSCP certifications and TS/SCI clearances. Contract is time-and-materials ceiling of 8.5 million dollars over three years. Full and open competition. Incumbent performance data will be provided to offerors upon request.

title: Data Analytics Platform and AI/ML Pilot
description: GSA seeks a data analytics platform pilot to improve acquisition spend visibility. Tasks include data ingestion from FPDS, building dashboards, and a proof-of-concept machine learning model to flag anomalous purchase patterns. Period of performance is 12 months, fixed-price. Offerors should describe responsible AI practices and data governance approach. Past performance with federal procurement data is a plus.

title: Facility Janitorial and Grounds Maintenance
agency: DEPT OF THE INTERIOR.NATIONAL PARK SERVICE
description: National Park Service requires janitorial and grounds maintenance at visitor centers and administrative buildings. Services include daily cleaning, restroom supplies, snow removal, and landscaping. One base year plus two option years. Service Contract Act wage determinations apply. A site visit is scheduled for November 12.

title: Office Supplies and Stationery Blanket Purchase Agreement
description: GSA seeks a blanket purchase agreement for office supplies, paper, toner-compatible stationery, and filing products for federal offices in the National Capital Region. Items must be delivered within 3 business days of order. Vendors must offer recycled-content paper meeting EPA guidelines. Firm-fixed-price unit pricing, one base year with four option years. Nonmanufacturer rule applies.

title: Bulk Janitorial Paper and Stationery Supply, Regional Offices
description: The VA requires recurring supply of stationery, notepads, envelopes, and general office supplies to 22 regional offices. Quarterly delivery schedule with a not-to-exceed value of 1.2 million dollars over two years. Quotes must include a delivery plan and a plan for handling backorders. Evaluation is lowest price technically acceptable.

title: Hand Soap and Personal Care Product Supply
description: Defense Logistics Agency requires liquid hand soap, shampoo, body wash, and lotion in institutional packaging for military installations. Products must be free of specified restricted ingredients and labeled per FDA requirements. Five-year indefinite-delivery contract with a guaranteed minimum of 50,000 dollars. Offerors must submit product safety data sheets and demonstrate manufacturing capacity.

title: Skin Care and Sunscreen Products for Field Personnel
agency: DEPT OF THE INTERIOR.NATIONAL PARK SERVICE
description: National Park Service seeks sunscreen, lip balm, and insect-repellent lotion for seasonal field staff. Products must have SPF 30 or higher and broad-spectrum protection. Single award, firm-fixed-price, delivery by March. Offerors must provide FDA OTC monograph compliance documentation.
